extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and contributors attempting to create or find an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for finding, creating, or troubleshooting a Wikipedia article with a given title (including account requirements, searching for existing pages, handling redirects, and checking deletion).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement to create new articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the page, log in or register and meet the autoconfirmed status before creating articles. If you cannot or prefer not to, use the article wizard or request a new article (see alternatives).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article as alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not ready or eligible to create a full article directly, submit a draft via the article wizard for review or file a request for a new article so others can create it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for alternative titles or spellings first
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for "Comedy during Bush" in Wikipedia to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, search existing articles to avoid duplication; check for variant spellings or slightly different titles that already cover the topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to the title (backlinks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding pages that link to the desired title can reveal related content, redirects, or existing coverage you might merge with instead of creating a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay and purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a newly created page to appear but it does not, wait a short time or use the purge function to refresh; database propagation delays can temporarily hide new pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants (apart from the first letter) when searching. If the correct article exists under a different capitalization, add a redirect from the missing title to the canonical one to help readers find it.

rubrics_metrics.name: If deleted, check deletion log and help pages
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a missing title results from deletion, consult the deletion log to learn why and follow the linked help/documentation (e.g., "Why was the page I created deleted?") to address deletion reasons or request undeletion.
